name: Recovery Report
query:
SELECT
    pe.name AS "ID:Link/Payment Entry:220",
    pe.posting_date AS "Posting Date:Date:100",
    pe.party_name AS "Party:Data:100",
    co.primary_address AS "Address:Data:220",
    per.bill_no AS "Bill No.:Data:100",
    per.total_amount AS "Bill Amount:Float:150",
    si.posting_date AS "Bill Date:Date:200",
    pe.bill_type AS "Bill:Data:150",
    co.territory AS "Area:Link/Territory:220",
    per.allocated_amount AS "Received Amount:Float:100",
    pe.mode_of_payment AS "Mode Of Payment:Data:100",
    pe.reference_no AS "Cheque#:Data:100",
    pe.reference_date AS "Cheque Date:Date:100",
    per.outstanding_amount AS "Balance Amount:Float:100"
    
    
FROM
    `tabPayment Entry` AS pe
LEFT JOIN
    `tabPayment Entry Reference` AS per ON per.parent = pe.name
LEFT JOIN
    `tabCustomer` AS co ON co.name = pe.party_name
LEFT JOIN
    `tabSales Invoice` AS si ON si.name = per.reference_name
    
 WHERE
    pe.docstatus = 1
    and pe.posting_date >= %(from_date)s and pe.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
    and co.territory = %(territory)s
    and pe.bill_type <> "Current Bill"
